lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: COLLEGE YEAR 4 — GRADUATING YEAR! Ito na ang huling stretch: Final Thesis Defense, OJT / Practicum, Graduation Clearance, at ang pinakahihintay na martsa!
lines.textEn: COLLEGE YEAR 4 — GRADUATING YEAR! The final stretch: Final Thesis Defense, OJT / Practicum, Graduation Clearance, and the march you fought years for!

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Senior na tayo, {name}! Isang kembot na lang, hindi na 'student discount' ang sasabihin natin sa jeep — 'bayad po, regular!'
lines.textEn: We are seniors, {name}! Almost done asking for student fare discounts on the jeep!

choices.text: Ibigay ang 100% sa huling taon — para kay Mama at sa sarili!
choices.textEn: Give everything to this final year — for Mama and for yourself!

journal.title: Huling Taon sa Kolehiyo!
journal.summary: Nagsimula ang 4th Year sa {course}. Abot-kamay na ang diploma!
journal.summaryEn: Started Senior Year in {course}. The diploma is within reach!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: FINAL THESIS DEFENSE DAY! Suot mo ang hiram na blazer, hawak ang hardbound drafts, at nakaharap sa tatlong panelists kasama si Prof. Reyes!
lines.textEn: FINAL THESIS DEFENSE DAY! Wearing a borrowed blazer, holding your printed drafts, facing three panelists including Prof. Reyes!

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Bago kayo mag-conclude, {name}: ano ang totoong impact ng study ninyo sa komunidad, at bakit namin ito dapat aprubahan ngayon?
lines.textEn: Before you conclude, {name}: what is the real-world impact of your study, and why should this panel approve it today?

choices.text: Sumagot mula sa data at puso — ipakita ang totoong kwento ng respondents!
choices.textEn: Answer with hard data and heart — highlight the real voices in your findings!

journal.title: THESIS DEFENDED!
journal.summary: Naipasa mo ang Final Thesis Defense sa {course}! Isang malaking tinik ang nabunot!
journal.summaryEn: Passed Final Thesis Defense in {course}! The biggest hurdle is cleared!

choices.text: Mag-cover ng budget snacks para sa panel at tapusin nang kalmado (-₱280).
choices.textEn: Keep the presentation steady and cover panel printing/snacks (-₱280).

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: APPROVED! TAPOS NA ANG THESIS! Gusto kong umiyak at kumain ng tatlong cups ng rice!
lines.textEn: APPROVED! THESIS IS DONE! I want to cry and eat three cups of rice!

lines.speaker: Aling Nena
lines.text: Libre na ang sabaw at extra rice niyo ngayong gabi! Congrats mga anak!
lines.textEn: Soup and extra rice are on the house tonight! Congrats, kids!

choices.text: Kain nang masaya kasama ang thesis team at si Aling Nena!
choices.textEn: Feast happily with your thesis team and Aling Nena!

lines.speaker: OJT Supervisor
lines.text: Malapit mo nang matapos ang 400+ hours mo sa OJT / Practicum para sa {course}, {name}! Impressive ang work ethic mo — eto ang intern allowance mo!
lines.textEn: You are almost done with your 400+ hours of {course} OJT / Practicum, {name}! Impressive work ethic — here is your intern allowance!

choices.text: Tanggapin ang intern allowance (+₱1,400) at magpasalamat sa team!
choices.textEn: Receive the intern allowance (+₱1,400) and thank the team!

journal.title: OJT / Practicum Completed!
journal.summary: Natapos mo ang OJT na may magandang evaluation at intern allowance!
journal.summaryEn: Completed your OJT with glowing evaluations and an intern stipend!

choices.text: Mag-volunteer sa extra client project para sa mas malaking bonus (+₱2,200, -Energy).
choices.textEn: Stay for an extra capstone deliverable for a bigger bonus (+₱2,200, -Energy).

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: GRADUATION CLEARANCE WEEK! Huling bayarin: Toga rental, graduation fee, yearbook/TOR processing, at final balance — ₱1,800 lahat!
lines.textEn: GRADUATION CLEARANCE WEEK! Final fees: Toga rental, graduation fee, TOR processing, and clearance — ₱1,800 total!

lines.speaker: Carlo
lines.text: Huling gastos na 'to, {name}! Pagkatapos ng pirma ng Accounting at Registrar, opisyal na graduate ka na!
lines.textEn: The very last fee, {name}! Once Accounting and Registrar sign off, you are officially a graduate!

choices.text: Bayaran ang Graduation Clearance nang buo (-₱1,800)!
choices.textEn: Pay the Graduation Clearance in full (-₱1,800)!

choices.text: Mag-promissory note sa Registrar at hiramin ang toga ni Kuya/Ate (-₱500).
choices.textEn: File a graduation promissory note and borrow a toga (-₱500).

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Bisperas ng Graduation. Nakasabit ang toga mo sa pader — katabi ng lumang coin purse mo na puno ng barya mula pa noong Grade 11.
lines.textEn: Graduation Eve. Your black toga hangs on the wall right beside the worn coin purse that carried you since Grade 11.

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.text: Nandito na kami ni Tatay sa Manila, anak! Maaga kami bukas sa auditorium. Hindi kami makatulog sa sobrang saya!
lines.textEn: Tatay and I just arrived in Manila, anak! We will be at the auditorium first thing tomorrow. Too proud to even sleep!

choices.text: Matulog nang mahimbing — bukas na ang pinakamalaking araw ng buhay mo!
choices.textEn: Sleep peacefully — tomorrow is the biggest day of your life!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: GRADUATION DAY! Tumutugtog ang Pomp and Circumstance. Nakaupo sina Mama, Tatay, Aling Nena, at ang buong barkada habang nakataas ang phone cameras nila.
lines.textEn: GRADUATION DAY! Pomp and Circumstance swells through the auditorium. Mama, Tatay, Aling Nena, and the entire barkada lift their cameras in tears.

lines.speaker: Dean
lines.text: Candidates for the degree of {course}... please rise! {name} — step forward to receive your diploma!
lines.textEn: Candidates for the degree of {course}... please rise! {name} — step forward to receive your diploma!

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Mula barya-baryang baon hanggang dito... PARA SA PAMILYA. PARA SA PANGARAP. GRADUATE NA AKO!
lines.textEn: From pocket coins all the way here... FOR FAMILY. FOR THE DREAM. I FINALLY GRADUATED!

choices.text: Umakyat sa entablado at tanggapin ang diploma!
choices.textEn: Walk across the stage and claim your diploma!

journal.title: COLLEGE GRADUATE!
journal.summary: Umakyat ka sa entablado at tinanggap ang diploma mo sa {course}!
journal.summaryEn: Walked the graduation stage and received your {course} diploma!

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Huling tambay natin bilang estudyante bago maging mga 'adulting' taxpayers! Thank you sa lahat, {name} — kahit barya lang dala natin, mayaman tayo sa alaala!
lines.textEn: Our last student hangout before full adulting and taxes! Thank you for everything, {name} — broke in cash, rich in memories!

choices.text: Cheers ng fishball at palamig! Friends forever!
choices.textEn: Cheers with fishballs and sweet gulaman! Friends forever!
